headline: Director buys 50,000 units on market at $2.18
summary: Small on-market purchase by a non-executive director.

headline: $85m placement at a 9.5% discount to buy 14 day-surgery clinics
summary: Dilutive raise funds most of a $120m acquisition, with the balance from debt. Management expects the deal to add to earnings per share in its first full year.

headline: Copper guidance cut after pit wall failure closes haul road
summary: FY27 production guidance falls about 15% at the midpoint and sustaining costs rise 12%. The main haul road is expected to be closed for eight weeks. No injuries.

headline: Revenue up 31% and first positive operating cash flow
summary: Half-year revenue of $48.2m, recurring revenue of $112m and $3.1m of operating cash flow. Full-year guidance unchanged.

headline: Chief Executive of six years resigns, effective 31 January 2027
summary: The board is searching internally and externally. The Chief Financial Officer will act as interim Chief Executive if no successor is appointed in time.

headline: All annual general meeting resolutions passed
summary: Routine result. No change to the business.
